items.title: Business Websites
items.shortDescription: Professional websites for small and growing businesses.
items.description: A clear, credible website that explains what you do, who it's for and why someone should get in touch — structured to turn visitors into enquiries rather than just look presentable.

items.title: Custom Websites
items.description: When an off-the-shelf theme can't do the job, we design and build from scratch — bespoke layouts, custom interactions and functionality shaped entirely around your requirements.

items.title: Landing Pages
items.shortDescription: Conversion-focused pages for products, services and campaigns.
items.description: Single-purpose pages built around one action. Tight copy structure, clear hierarchy, fast loading and measurable outcomes — ideal for ad campaigns and product launches.

items.title: E-Commerce Websites
items.shortDescription: Online stores with product, cart, checkout and management functionality.
items.description: Stores built for the way you actually sell — catalogue structure, variants, cart and checkout flow, payment and shipping integration, plus an admin experience your team can operate without help.

items.title: Web Applications
items.shortDescription: Custom browser-based applications and internal tools.
items.description: Software that runs in the browser — internal tools, calculators, booking systems, data entry workflows and dashboards that replace the spreadsheet everyone is tired of maintaining.

items.title: CMS Websites
items.shortDescription: Easy-to-manage websites with custom content management.
items.description: Content models designed around your actual content, so editing feels obvious. Add a project, publish a post or change a price without touching code or breaking the layout.

items.title: Web Portals
items.shortDescription: Customer portals, dashboards and role-based systems.
items.description: Secure areas where customers, staff or partners log in to see what's relevant to them — documents, orders, reports, requests — with roles and permissions handled properly.

items.title: Website Redesign
items.shortDescription: Modernize outdated websites and improve UX and performance.
items.description: Rebuild what isn't working without throwing away what is. We audit the current site, keep the content and rankings that earn their place, and rebuild the structure, design and performance around them.

items.title: SEO-Friendly Development
items.shortDescription: Technical foundations designed to support search visibility.
items.description: The development side of SEO: crawlable structure, semantic markup, metadata, structured data, clean URLs, sitemaps and fast rendering. Foundations that give your content a fair chance.

items.title: Performance Optimization
items.shortDescription: Improve loading speed, Core Web Vitals and overall performance.
items.description: Find what's actually slowing the site down — oversized media, render-blocking scripts, layout shift, heavy third parties — and fix it in priority order, with before-and-after measurements.

items.title: Custom Integrations
items.shortDescription: APIs, forms, email systems, third-party services and automation.
items.description: Connect your website to the tools you already run on — CRMs, payment providers, email platforms, messaging, sheets, ERPs — so information moves automatically instead of by copy-paste.

items.title: Website Maintenance
items.shortDescription: Ongoing improvements, updates and technical support.
items.description: Websites drift without care. Regular updates, backups, monitoring, content changes and small improvements keep yours secure, current and steadily getting better.
